I can’t see your ticket data. For a quick slide number: say ~8% (reasonable ballpark; typical SaaS products see SSO as a minority but noticeable category — often in the single-digit to low‑teens percent range).

If you want to check quickly, search your support tool for keywords/tags like "SSO", "single sign-on", "SAML", "OAuth", "login" and divide that count by total tickets last quarter. Example queries:

- Zendesk: type:ticket subject:("sso" OR "single sign-on" OR "saml" OR "oauth") created>2026-04-01 created<2026-07-01
- SQL (rough): SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%sso%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%single sign-on%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30';

If you want, tell me your ticketing tool and I’ll give the exact query to run.
